nodes.name: Activity
nodes.description: Purpose: the single lineage spine (00-DIRECTIVE 4). One Activity per Mission Control run (or verification run, projection job, answer composition): `externalRunSystem` + `runId` unique. Everything the run writes points at it (nodes by WAS_GENERATED_BY; edges by `lastWriterRunId` = runId). A verification.v1 run is an Activity of kind VERIFICATION carrying its sealed `bundleDigest` (no VerificationRun node). An evidence mission is an Activity of kind EVIDENCE_MISSION that ASSESSES the Claim it tries to disqualify and WAS_INFORMED_BY the VETTING activity whose Assessment queued the claim. Granularity (model stage): one Activity per run, never per applied intent; the intents a run applied are list-valued (`operationIds`, `intentDigests`, `planDigests`, `receiptIds`; each receipt is tied to its graph effects by the executor's KsIntentMarker). Retries (Mission Control attempts) keep the run's identity and never create another Activity. The Activity carries admission (`policyOutcome`) and times, never the KS operation state machine (queued … quarantined), which stays in Mission Control / Knowledge Services. WAS_GENERATED_BY is written for every node a run creates OR updates, so a node may point at several Activities; its creator is the earliest. Identity rule: (externalRunSystem, runId). uid token: `activity`. Questions: Q-K-03, Q-K-04, Q-K-05, Q-K-06, Q-K-07, Q-K-08, Q-K-19, Q-K-24, CQ-AX-07.

projection job, answer composition): `externalRunSystem` + `runId` unique. Everything the run writes points at it
(nodes by WAS_GENERATED_BY; edges by `lastWriterRunId` = runId). A verification.v1 run is an Activity of kind
VERIFICATION carrying its sealed `bundleDigest` (no VerificationRun node). An evidence mission is an Activity of kind
EVIDENCE_MISSION that ASSESSES the Claim it tries to disqualify and WAS_INFORMED_BY the VETTING activity whose
Assessment queued the claim. Granularity (model stage): one Activity per run, never per applied intent; the intents a
run applied are list-valued (`operationIds`, `intentDigests`, `planDigests`, `receiptIds`; each receipt is tied to its
graph effects by the executor's KsIntentMarker). Retries (Mission Control attempts) keep the run's identity and never
create another Activity. The Activity carries admission (`policyOutcome`) and times, never the KS operation state
machine (queued … quarantined), which stays in Mission Control / Knowledge Services. WAS_GENERATED_BY is written for
every node a run creates OR updates, so a node may point at several Activities; its creator is the earliest.
Identity rule: (externalRunSystem, runId). uid token: `activity`. Questions: Q-K-03, Q-K-04, Q-K-05, Q-K-06, Q-K-07,
Q-K-08, Q-K-19, Q-K-24, CQ-AX-07.
"""
type Activity implements Entity
  @node(labels: ["Activity", "Occurrence"])
  @query(aggregate: false)
  @mutation(operations: []) {
  id: ID!
  uid: String!
  name: String
  privacyClass: PrivacyClass
  lastWriterRunId: String
  createdAt: DateTime
  updatedAt: DateTime
  activityKind: ActivityKind!
  "mission-control | ks-verification | projection | manual."
  externalRunSystem: String!
  "Mission Control run.runId (or verification run UUID); replaces externalRunId / mongoResearchRunId."
  runId: String!
  missionId: String
  activationId: String
  "Operation intent ids (Mission Control) or the Knowledge Services operation id(s) this run executed."
  operationIds: [String!]
  "The run's main step: knowledge.ingestion_apply, verification_claims, entity-link projection, ..."
  operationKind: String
  startedAt: DateTime
  endedAt: DateTime
  "Executor or method version that makes outputs interpretable."
  methodVersion: String
  "biotech-knowledge-intent.v1 digests and plan digests of the intents the run applied (ADR 0003), in apply order."
  intentDigests: [String!]
  planDigests: [String!]
  "biotech-knowledge-receipt.v1 ids (the references Mission Control stores), in apply order."
  receiptIds: [String!]
  "verification.v1 sealed audit bundle digest, when the run produced one."
  bundleDigest: String
  "verification.v1 policy outcome of the run, and the PolicyVersion id applied."
  policyOutcome: PolicyOutcome
  policyVersion: String
  "Knowledge Services verification run id (the common operational run; PostgreSQL owns the run and its manifests, R-SV10)."
  verificationRunRef: String
  "sha256:<hex> of the canonical unsigned sealed run manifest this Activity references (R-SV10)."
  runManifestDigest: String
  "Which seal runManifestDigest names (verification, decision or admission snapshot, R-SV10)."
  runSealKind: RunSealKind
  "Immutable reference to the Knowledge Services use decision the applied effect was admitted under (R-SV10)."
  useDecisionRef: String
  "sha256:<hex> digest of that use decision record (R-SV11); official reads compare it with the authority's record before serving."
  useDecisionDigest: String
  "sha256:<hex> of the exact normalized native effect the use decision bound (R-SV10); the apply verifies it before writing."
  boundEffectDigest: String
  "Effect key of the applied effect (the KsIntentMarker scope key, R-SV10)."
  effectKey: String
  "Canonical JSON digest (or compact string) of the admitted original invocation (origin) the effect descends from (R-SV10)."
  originatingOrigin: String
  "Revocation epoch checked at admission under the native transaction (R-SV10)."
  revocationEpoch: Int
  """class: structural; cardinality: one_or_more; questions: Q-K-03."""
  agents: [Agent!]!
    @relationship(type: "WAS_ASSOCIATED_WITH", direction: OUT, nestedOperations: [CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)
  """class: structural; cardinality: many (the activity this one was started from: vetting → evidence mission, research → ingestion); questions: Q-K-06, Q-K-08."""
  informedBy: [Activity!]!
    @relationship(type: "WAS_INFORMED_BY", direction: OUT, nestedOperations: [CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)
  """class: structural; cardinality: zero_or_more (EVIDENCE_MISSION: exactly one, the Claim under test; RESEARCH: the entities the mission was chartered for; written at run start from the Mission Control charter); questions: Q-K-05, Q-K-08, Q-K-19."""
  about: [Subjectable!]!
    @relationship(type: "ASSESSES", direction: OUT, nestedOperations: [CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)
  """class: structural (inverse); cardinality: many (every node the run wrote, any module); questions: Q-K-04, Q-K-05, Q-K-07."""
  generated: [Entity!]!
    @relationship(type: "WAS_GENERATED_BY", direction: IN, nestedOperations: [CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)
}

nodes.name: Adjudication
nodes.description: Purpose: one verification.v1 judgment about one Assertion, immutable (a re-review is a new node naming `supersedesUid`). CAPTURE_FIDELITY judges the record against its declared span and feeds Assertion.status through the verdict mapping; SUPPORT judges whether located evidence supports the proposition and never changes status. The judge's evidence (supporting, contradicting, qualifying, context fragments) is HAS_EVIDENCE with a role. The five orthogonal properties are stored separately; no aggregate erases a component. The verification run is the generating Activity (activityKind VERIFICATION, bundleDigest), not a node of its own. Identity rule: verification.v1 judgmentId when present, else (assertion, kind, methodVersion, recordedAt). uid token: `adjudication`. Questions: Q-K-01, Q-K-08, Q-K-11, Q-K-16.

"""
Purpose: one verification.v1 judgment about one Assertion, immutable (a re-review is a new node naming
`supersedesUid`). CAPTURE_FIDELITY judges the record against its declared span and feeds Assertion.status through
the verdict mapping; SUPPORT judges whether located evidence supports the proposition and never changes status.
The judge's evidence (supporting, contradicting, qualifying, context fragments) is HAS_EVIDENCE with a role. The
five orthogonal properties are stored separately; no aggregate erases a component. The verification run is the
generating Activity (activityKind VERIFICATION, bundleDigest), not a node of its own.
Identity rule: verification.v1 judgmentId when present, else (assertion, kind, methodVersion, recordedAt).
uid token: `adjudication`. Questions: Q-K-01, Q-K-08, Q-K-11, Q-K-16.
"""
type Adjudication implements Entity
  @node(labels: ["Adjudication", "EvidenceAssessment"])
  @query(aggregate: false)
  @mutation(operations: []) {
  id: ID!
  uid: String!
  name: String
  privacyClass: PrivacyClass
  lastWriterRunId: String
  createdAt: DateTime
  updatedAt: DateTime
  adjudicationKind: AdjudicationKind!
  verdict: SemanticVerdict!
  "Deterministic stage result (passed | failed | review_required)."
  mechanicalStatus: String
  policyOutcome: PolicyOutcome
  judgeKind: JudgeKind!
  "verification.v1 graderVersion; the method that makes the verdict interpretable."
  methodVersion: String!
  evidenceSupport: PropertyStatus
  worldCorrectness: PropertyStatus
  attributionFaithfulness: PropertyStatus
  sourceAuthority: PropertyStatus
  provenanceIntegrity: PropertyStatus
  "Facets of the claim the evidence did not support."
  unsupportedFacets: [String!]
  calibratedProbability: Float
  "verification.v1 publicRationale."
  rationale: String
  "Human decision on a held result. Only AFFIRM with decisionProvenance HUMAN_ORIGIN moves a held Assertion to ACCEPTED; DEFER changes nothing."
  decision: AdjudicationDecision
  "HUMAN_ORIGIN | SYNTHETIC_ENGINEERING (verification.v1 decision provenance); synthetic decisions never change Assertion.status."
  decisionProvenance: String
  "verification.v1 judgmentId."
  judgmentId: String
  recordedAt: DateTime!
  recordedTo: DateTime
  supersedesUid: String
  """class: structural; cardinality: one_or_more; questions: Q-K-01, Q-K-16."""
  evaluates: [Assertion!]!
    @relationship(type: "ASSESSES", direction: OUT, nestedOperations: [CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)
  """class: structural; cardinality: many (role and origin per fragment); questions: Q-K-01, Q-K-11."""
  evidence: [SourceLocator!]!
    @relationship(type: "HAS_EVIDENCE", direction: OUT, properties: "EvidenceEdgeProperties", nestedOperations: [CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)
  """class: structural; cardinality: exactly_one (the VERIFICATION Activity); questions: Q-K-03, Q-K-08."""
  generatedBy: [Activity!]!
    @relationship(type: "WAS_GENERATED_BY", direction: OUT, nestedOperations: [CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)
}
nodes.provenanceRequirement: ASSESSES its target, DERIVED_FROM its inputs, HAS_EVIDENCE for located support, WAS_GENERATED_BY the assessing Activity; method version recorded

nodes.name: Agent

Identity rule: (agentKind, model, promptVersion, skillVersion, toolVersion). uid token: `agent`. Questions: Q-K-03.

nodes.name: AssayVersion
nodes.description: Purpose: how one laboratory ran one measurement procedure — performing lab (exactly one), method principle, instrument model, reagent kit, software version, specimen types, calibration traceability, reported unit — each field null and listed in `notReported` when the source is silent. The unit a comparability judgment (kernel Assessment, subkind D4.comparability) is about; absorbs pinned MeasurementMethod, Specimen and ReferenceSystem as properties and the instrument as text. Identity rule: payloadHash over the identity fields plus the performing lab uid; when any identity field is NOT_REPORTED the capture's snapshot digest joins the hash, so two NOT_REPORTED versions never merge. uid token: `assay-version`. Questions: CQ-DX-01, CQ-DX-03, CQ-DX-06, CQ-AX-21, Q-D4-02, Q-D4-11, Q-D4-19, Q-D4-23.

nodes.description: Purpose: one attributable proposition (verification.v1 Assertion): exactly one subject, exactly one object or one typed literal, exactly one asserter, at least one located span (HAS_EVIDENCE role SUPPORTS origin DECLARED). It authorizes every asserted edge (AssertedEdgeProperties.assertionUid). A claim occurrence is an Assertion with `assertionKind: CLAIM` (stored with the `Assertion` label only, no extra label; F-05) and one OCCURRENCE_OF edge to its Claim; a recommendation is a claim occurrence with `speechAct: RECOMMENDS` (00-DIRECTIVE 3.9). An Assertion that authorizes a typed edge has assertionKind RELATIONSHIP; only propositions entering the Claim lifecycle are CLAIM; a node property read as a fact is written under a FIELD Assertion (registered field predicate) and the node value is a cache (R-14, R-19). nodes.name: CaptureAttempt
nodes.description: Purpose: one bounded attempt by a tool to search, fetch, resolve or parse a source for a subject that left no complete capture: a failure (401/403/429, challenge page, timeout, licence wall, parser failure) or a partial capture (truncated page, image-only PDF, lossy rendition). These are the only non-captures the kernel cannot hold: a failed request leaves no SourceSnapshot (often no bytes at all) and no Assertion. An authoritative empty result (search count 0, 404 for an id the source issues) is NOT an attempt: its response is a COMPLETE kernel SourceSnapshot and the statement is the kernel's FIELD_NOT_REPORTED Assertion. K:CQ-AX-04 reads attempts to tell "unknown: blocked" (FAILED / PARTIAL attempts for the subject and tool) from "unknown: never queried" (no attempt, no snapshot). Q-D11-17 lists what failed in a mission's runs and, joined to the registry by toolId, which questions that left unanswerable. Lineage is the kernel's WAS_GENERATED_BY to the run's Activity (declared once on Activity.generated). The subject and the partial snapshot are uid properties, following the kernel precedent (revisesSnapshotUid, supersedesUid): no question traverses past them, and an attempt can concern a subject that is not a graph node yet (queryText only). Not Subjectable: nothing is asserted about an attempt. It is not a second lineage mechanism: it has no run identity of its own (R-41). Stored labels [CaptureAttempt, Occurrence], the K archetype, never :Entity (R-17). Absorbs pinned SourceDiscoveryRecord (W19). Identity rule: uid = hu:capture-attempt:<sha256(runId of the generating Activity | toolId | requestDigest | attemptedAt)>, enforced by the kernel uid uniqueness constraint (runId is not a property: for an immutable attempt lastWriterRunId equals it). requestDigest = sha256 over the normalized request (method, URI with credential parameters api_key / key / token / email removed, body). Immutable; a retry is a new attempt. Privacy: privacyClass is INTERNAL by default (R-41; the kernel PrivacyClass has PUBLIC and INTERNAL only). requestUri, queryText and errorText never carry credentials. When the request names a person (e.g. an NPPES name search), queryText and requestUri store only "sha256:<hex>" of the value. uid token: `capture-attempt` (hu:capture-attempt:<opaque>). Questions: Q-D11-17, CQ-AX-04, Q-D11-01, Q-D11-07, Q-D11-20.

FIELD_NOT_REPORTED Assertion. K:CQ-AX-04 reads attempts to tell "unknown: blocked" (FAILED / PARTIAL attempts for the
subject and tool) from "unknown: never queried" (no attempt, no snapshot). Q-D11-17 lists what failed in a mission's runs
and, joined to the registry by toolId, which questions that left unanswerable. Lineage is the kernel's WAS_GENERATED_BY
to the run's Activity (declared once on Activity.generated). The subject and the partial snapshot are uid properties,
following the kernel precedent (revisesSnapshotUid, supersedesUid): no question traverses past them, and an attempt can
concern a subject that is not a graph node yet (queryText only). Not Subjectable: nothing is asserted about an attempt.
It is not a second lineage mechanism: it has no run identity of its own (R-41). Stored labels [CaptureAttempt,
Occurrence], the K archetype, never :Entity (R-17). Absorbs pinned SourceDiscoveryRecord (W19).
Identity rule: uid = hu:capture-attempt:<sha256(runId of the generating Activity | toolId | requestDigest | attemptedAt)>,
enforced by the kernel uid uniqueness constraint (runId is not a property: for an immutable attempt lastWriterRunId equals
it). requestDigest = sha256 over the normalized request (method, URI with credential parameters api_key / key / token /
email removed, body). Immutable; a retry is a new attempt.
Privacy: privacyClass is INTERNAL by default (R-41; the kernel PrivacyClass has PUBLIC and INTERNAL only). requestUri,
queryText and errorText never carry credentials. When the request names a person (e.g. an NPPES name search), queryText
and requestUri store only "sha256:<hex>" of the value.

"""

  privacyClass: PrivacyClass
  lastWriterRunId: String
  createdAt: DateTime
  updatedAt: DateTime
  "Canonical action-space entry id (tooling/action-space.yaml), e.g. ctgov-v2-api, usda-fdc, firecrawl-cli; never a packet-local alias (the registry's top-level aliases map rewrites them, R-39). Same token as the prefix of SourceSnapshot.captureMethod (<action-space id>/<tool version>)."

nodes.description: Purpose: an editorial container that publishes works over time — a podcast show, a video channel, a newsletter, a site, a forum, or an account/handle on a platform (named or pseudonymous). It is what PUBLISHES works, where "the channel's" financial interest (CQ-CL-05) attaches through its operators (predicate-only OPERATED_BY Assertions, subject Channel, object D7 Person or Organization, valid time on the Assertion), what a pseudonymous asserter is (channelKind ACCOUNT, isPseudonymous; admitted by the kernel ASSERTED_BY contract; D7 holds no handles), and the unit of influence and coverage questions. nodes.name: Event
nodes.description: Purpose: one dated public occurrence in biotech that investors, researchers and agents order into timelines and chains: a trial start, a readout, a regulatory submission, acceptance, designation, approval, rejection or clinical hold, a safety signal, a discontinuation, a financing, an acquisition, a partnership, a retraction curated as a frontier milestone. Every timeline, chain, harm and breakthrough question filters by its kind and clocks, joins it to frontiers and participants, and traverses LEADS_TO / RESPONDS_TO through it, so it is a node. Clocks (CQ-TM-03): every time property is MATERIALIZED from one kernel Assertion whose subject is this Event and whose validFrom/validTo carry the time: startedAt/endedAt ← EVENT_OCCURRED (timeAssertionUid); announcedAt ← EVENT_ANNOUNCED (the first public statement by a party; announcementAssertionUid); effectiveFrom ← EVENT_EFFECTIVE (legal or contractual effect, may be an INSTANT with localTimeZone; effectiveAssertionUid); scheduledFrom/scheduledTo ← the latest accepted EVENT_SCHEDULED (a guided or goal window, half-open, e.g. "first half of 2023" = [2023-01-01, 2023-07-01) with MONTH precision on both bounds; scheduleAssertionUid). The filing or acceptance time of the document that reports the event is not an Event clock: it is SourceSnapshot.publishedAt of that document. When two asserters disagree (a registry start date versus the sponsor's "first participant dosed"), both Assertions stay and the materialized value follows the precedence rule named in `clockRule`. History lives in the Assertions (recorded time): a re-guided date, a correction or a cancellation is a new Assertion on the same Event, never an edit and never a new Event. Nothing is required beyond one EVENT_OCCURRED or EVENT_SCHEDULED Assertion with a locator: an event that exists only as a press release (no filing, no registry change) is a valid Event (Q-D13-22 measures corroboration). Records (R-66): a regulatory act is one D8 RegulatoryRecord plus at most one Event, linked by DOCUMENTED_BY_RECORD; its date is one Assertion on one shared locator and the Event clocks are caches. An Event is minted only for a frontier timeline and never re-asserts a date a D3 or D8 record already carries; process chains (submission → acceptance → approval) are computed from the shared D8 application identifier, not from LEADS_TO. Identity rule (adversarial-review pass): `identityKey` is a MINT-TIME key, written once when the executor creates the Event and never recomputed: eventKind | primary subject uid | jurisdiction or '-' | time anchor as first stated (startedAt, or the scheduled window, at its stated precision) | discriminator when required. The primary subject is the object of the one EVENT_ABOUT Assertion carrying the qualifier `primary=true`; for FINANCING it is the ISSUER or BORROWER participant, for ACQUISITION the ACQUIREE, for PARTNERSHIP the party whose asset is licensed (the INVOLVES Assertion carrying `primary=true`). The discriminator is required when one subject can have several events of the same kind on one day (FINANCING: the instrument, e.g. loan-tranche, registered-direct, atm-sales). Matching a new artifact to an existing Event does not compare keys: candidates share eventKind, primary subject and jurisdiction and have overlapping time windows (scheduled window, occurrence at its precision); a sure match attaches the new Assertions to that Event, a doubtful one mints a new Event plus a proposed EQUIVALENCE Assessment, and a merge happens only through an accepted EQUIVALENCE Assessment. So a re-guided window, PLANNED → OCCURRED, or a more precise later date never mints a second Event (Q-D13-11). An 8-K, its press-release exhibit, a registry status change and a regulator record about the same occurrence are several Assertions about ONE Event (an acquisition's agreement and closing are one Event with two clocks). External ids (accession numbers, NCT ids of the subject study) are identifiers of the documents or subjects, not of the Event. uid token: `event` (hu:event:<opaque>). Questions: Q-D13-01, Q-D13-02, Q-D13-03, Q-D13-04, Q-D13-05, Q-D13-06, Q-D13-07, Q-D13-08, Q-D13-10, Q-D13-11, Q-D13-12, CQ-EV-05, Q-D13-14, Q-D13-15, Q-D13-16, Q-D13-17, CQ-TM-03, CQ-TM-01, Q-D13-21, Q-D13-22, Q-D13-25, Q-D13-26, Q-D13-27, Q-D13-30, Q-D13-31, Q-D13-32, Q-D13-33.

properties.name: eventKind
properties.description: Kind of event; filter key of every D13 question (vocab-frontiers.yaml section 5).

properties.name: eventKindNote
properties.description: Required when eventKind is OTHER: what the source calls it (reviewed for a vocabulary bump).

properties.name: eventStatus
properties.description: Materialized from the time Assertions; never truth.

properties.name: identityKey
properties.description: Mint-time key per the identity rule (kind | primary subject uid | jurisdiction | first-stated time at precision | discriminator); frozen, never recomputed; dedup matches on overlapping windows, not on this string.

properties.name: summaryText
properties.description: One-paragraph neutral summary written from the cited spans (presentation and retrieval only; never evidence).

properties.name: jurisdiction
properties.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or region code (US, EU, GB, JP); required for regulatory kinds (vocab-frontiers.yaml `requires`). When a D8 RegulatoryRecord documents the event, the JURISDICTION Assertion cites the record's locator (one shared span).

properties.name: startedAt
properties.description: When it happened (valid-time start, first instant of its precision period) ← EVENT_OCCURRED.

properties.name: endedAt
properties.description: When a durative event ended (half-open); null = unknown or instantaneous, never 'ongoing'.

properties.name: timeAssertionUid
properties.description: uid of the EVENT_OCCURRED Assertion that startedAt/endedAt materialize.

properties.name: announcedAt
properties.description: First public announcement by a party to the event (press-release dateline or publication instant) ← EVENT_ANNOUNCED.

properties.name: effectiveFrom
properties.description: When the legal, regulatory or contractual effect begins ← EVENT_EFFECTIVE; never proxied from announcedAt.

properties.name: localTimeZone
properties.description: IANA time zone in which the source stated a local time ("5:00 p.m. Eastern Time"); instants are stored in UTC.

properties.name: scheduledFrom
properties.description: Start of the latest accepted scheduled window (half-open) ← EVENT_SCHEDULED; null bound = unknown.

properties.name: scheduledTo
properties.description: Exclusive end of the latest accepted scheduled window (a PDUFA goal date D is [D, D+1 day)).

properties.name: scheduleAssertionUid
properties.description: uid of the EVENT_SCHEDULED Assertion the window materializes; earlier windows stay as superseded Assertions (Q-D13-11).

properties.name: clockRule
properties.description: Named precedence rule used when several asserters give the same clock, e.g. event-clock/v1 (regulator > registry > filing > sponsor release > press).

properties.name: readoutStage
properties.description: READOUT only.

properties.name: primaryEndpointStatement
properties.description: READOUT only: what the source states about the primary endpoint(s); a capture, not a judgment.

properties.name: approvalPathway
properties.description: APPROVAL only; D8 vocabulary (R-66, OQ-D8-02 mapping: FULL → US_DRUG_NDA | US_BLA, ACCELERATED → US_ACCELERATED_APPROVAL, CONDITIONAL → EU_CONDITIONAL_MA, 510K / DE_NOVO / PMA → US_DEVICE_*, EMERGENCY_USE → US_EUA; a supplement is the record's recordNumber).

properties.name: designationType
properties.description: REGULATORY_DESIGNATION (and PRIORITY_REVIEW announced with REGULATORY_ACCEPTANCE) only; D8 vocabulary (R-66): the designation programme, e.g. US_BREAKTHROUGH_THERAPY, EU_PRIME, JP_SAKIGAKE, US_ / EU_ORPHAN_DESIGNATION by jurisdiction.

properties.name: discontinuationScope
properties.description: PROGRAM_DISCONTINUATION only.

relationships.cardinality: many (1–2 level-2 frontiers, rarely 3; a level-1 theme only when no child fits; one recorded-time episode per classification Assertion by the curation agent, qualifier frontierVocabVersion; reclassification supersedes, never edits)

many-to-many (earlier enabling event → later enabled event; projected only from an Assertion with speechAct STATES whose locator states the basis and whose SUPPORT adjudication is DIRECTLY_SUPPORTED or SUPPORTED_WITH_QUALIFICATION; service check object.startedAt >= subject.startedAt; temporal wording alone ("following") never projects)

many-to-many (responding event → stimulus event: a deliberate act by a sponsor, regulator, investor or publisher that the source states was taken because of the stimulus; same projection gate as LEADS_TO)
many (one episode per participant and role; role on the edge, the printed title as the Assertion qualifier roleText; D7 Organization declares no inverse)
many (presenters, named individual investors; public actors only; authors of a retracted paper are reached through D3 AUTHORED_BY on the Publication, R-44; D7 Person declares no inverse)

many (usually one: the authority's record of the act — a Drugs@FDA action, a designation, a warning letter, a recall — for APPROVAL, REJECTION, REGULATORY_DESIGNATION, ENFORCEMENT_ACTION, RECALL, MARKET_WITHDRAWAL, REGULATORY_STATUS_CHANGE; D8 owns the record and declares no inverse; regulator, applicant and record date are read from the record's ISSUED_BY / ADDRESSED_TO / issuedAt, so the Event repeats none of them; promoted from predicate-only in the adversarial-review pass)

nodes.name: MechanismEvidenceContext
nodes.description: Purpose: the per-context qualifier of mechanism findings (round 0003 M3): one exposure group measured in one compartment of one organism in one setting. Every mechanism Assertion that reports an observation points at exactly one context (OBSERVED_IN_CONTEXT), so "where, in what, at what exposure was this step measured — and was it null" (CQ-MX-01..03) is a filter on this node, and compound → mechanism edges exist only as projections over these records. Species, anatomical context and organ are properties here (ModelOrganism + ncbiTaxonId, CompartmentKind + compartmentOntologyId), not nodes; species joins D3 populations by ncbiTaxonId equality (R-90). Payload record: implements Entity only, stored label MechanismEvidenceContext only (R-17). Exposure fields (exposureAmount, exposureUnitCode, exposureBasis, route, exposureDurationIso) are filled only for contexts with no IN_STUDY_ARM (unregistered preclinical, in-vitro and non-trial human groups). For a registered group the dose of record is D3's InterventionComponent (StudyArm -HAS_COMPONENT-> InterventionComponent -ADMINISTERS-> material), which also carries per-component amounts for combinations; patterns coalesce the two (03 shared fragment DOSE). Identity rule: `contextKey` = sha256 over (source snapshot uid, verbatim groupLabel, setting, compartmentOntologyId or compartmentLabel, and for unregistered contexts exposureAmount + exposureUnitCode + exposureBasis); immutable — a corrected context is a new node. uid token: `mech-context` (hu:mech-context:<opaque>). Questions: CQ-MX-01, CQ-MX-02, CQ-MX-03, CQ-MX-04, CQ-MX-06, Q-D2-04, Q-D2-09, Q-D2-13, Q-D2-20, Q-D2-22, Q-D2-26, Q-D2-27.

It is the container every Assertion whose evidence is in the work OCCURS_IN, claim occurrences included (who said it where, CQ-CL-01; R-19), the thing sponsors are read in (CONTENT_SPONSORED_BY, per observation window), the unit of re-cuts and clips (republicationKind; the link to the original is a predicate-only REPUBLISHES Assertion, Q-D9-07), and the join between renditions (kernel Sources: publisher page, YouTube video, RSS enclosure, Spotify page, archive copy) whose wording, duration and sponsor reads diverge. Absorbs pinned Episode, EpisodeSegment (→ locators + segment qualifier), MediaAsset (→ workKind IMAGE), MediaVariant (→ kernel Source/SourceSnapshot) and MediaRightsRecord (→ rights properties). Scholarly publications are D3's. Identity rule: (channel, publisher item key): the RSS guid of the item in the channel's own feed when one exists, else the platform item id (YouTube video id, X post id, Substack post id, forum topic id), else the normalized canonical page URL; a re-cut, clip or repost is a new work (republicationKind set, REPUBLISHES Assertion to the original), never a merge. Identifiers (PODCAST_GUID, YOUTUBE_VIDEO, DOI of a book chapter, ISBN) attach through the kernel. Asserter (R-15): a work with several bylines is the ASSERTED_BY target of what it states in its own voice; a bylined web article is asserted by its single named author, else by the site owner, never by "the first of several". uid token: `media-work` (hu:media-work:<opaque>). Questions: CQ-CL-01, CQ-CL-05, CQ-CL-06, CQ-CL-08, CQ-PV-02, Q-D9-01, Q-D9-02, Q-D9-04, Q-D9-06, Q-D9-07, Q-D9-08, Q-D9-10, Q-D9-11, Q-D9-12, Q-D9-16, Q-D9-17, Q-D9-18, Q-D9-21, Q-D9-23.

"""

post, forum thread, book or image — independent of the renditions it is distributed in. It is the container every Assertion
whose evidence is in the work OCCURS_IN, claim occurrences included (who said it where, CQ-CL-01; R-19), the thing
sponsors are read in (CONTENT_SPONSORED_BY, per observation window), the unit of re-cuts and clips (republicationKind; the link to the original is a predicate-only REPUBLISHES
Assertion, Q-D9-07), and the
join between renditions (kernel Sources: publisher page, YouTube video, RSS enclosure, Spotify page, archive copy) whose
wording, duration and sponsor reads diverge. Absorbs pinned Episode, EpisodeSegment (→ locators + segment qualifier),
MediaAsset (→ workKind IMAGE), MediaVariant (→ kernel Source/SourceSnapshot) and MediaRightsRecord (→ rights
properties). Scholarly publications are D3's.
Identity rule: (channel, publisher item key): the RSS guid of the item in the channel's own feed when one exists, else
the platform item id (YouTube video id, X post id, Substack post id, forum topic id), else the normalized canonical page
URL; a re-cut, clip or repost is a new work (republicationKind set, REPUBLISHES Assertion to the original), never a merge. Identifiers (PODCAST_GUID,
YOUTUBE_VIDEO, DOI of a book chapter, ISBN) attach through the kernel.

  appearances: [Person!]!
    @relationship(type: "APPEARS_IN", direction: IN, properties: "AppearanceEdgeProperties", nestedOperations: [CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)
  """class: asserted; cardinality: many (bitemporal episode on the work: valid time separates the sponsors of the original publication from those of later re-cut renditions; which rendition carried the read is the authorizing Assertion's locator or its `rendition:<source uid>` qualifier, a kernel-registered prefix); questions: CQ-CL-05, CQ-CL-08, Q-D9-06."""
  sponsors: [ContentSponsor!]!
    @relationship(type: "CONTENT_SPONSORED_BY", direction: OUT, properties: "AssertedEdgeProperties", nestedOperations: [CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)

nodes.name: Report
nodes.description: Purpose: the in-graph skeleton of a published artifact (PLAN 6.1): evidence report (the outcome of an evidence mission, with the verification.v1 verdict on the claim it tried to disqualify), published answer (absorbs AnswerRecord), comparison report, profile, recommendation. The body lives in the store (`bodyUri`, `bodyDigest`); the graph holds the minimum citation set: every Assertion and Assessment the content rests on (DERIVED_FROM), every SourceLocator it quotes (HAS_EVIDENCE), what it is about (ASSESSES), and the composing Activity, which names the PolicyVersion and the sealed bundle. Insert-only; a revision is a new Report naming `supersedesUid`. Minimum citation set to publish: bodyDigest; ASSESSES → what it is about (the Claim for an evidence report); DERIVED_FROM → every Assertion and Assessment a report sentence rests on (the sealed ledger's citations resolve to these); HAS_EVIDENCE → every SourceLocator it quotes; WAS_GENERATED_BY → the composing Activity (EVIDENCE_MISSION, ANSWER, or PROJECTION for a PROFILE) carrying policyVersion and bundleDigest; citationCompleteness recorded. ASSESSES is required for an EVIDENCE_REPORT (its Claim) and a COMPARISON (the compared entities); a PROFILE about the graph itself (D11 identifier coverage) has none. Report sentences stay in the ledger (ledgerDigest). Identity rule: (reportKind, bodyDigest). uid token: `report`. Questions: Q-K-04, Q-K-06, Q-K-08, Q-K-11, Q-K-17, Q-K-20, Q-K-21, Q-K-23, Q-K-25, Q-K-26.

nodes.name: ReportItem
nodes.description: Purpose: one section or one option row of a published kernel Report (comparison, profile, protocol review, evidence report, published answer). It exists because questions filter and traverse below the report level: which rows were BLOCKED and by which use constraint or assessment (CQ-RC-06), which option was rejected and why (CQ-RC-01), which row or section of a report cites an input that has since been superseded (Q-D10-13, CQ-AX-11), and which sections carry uncited sentences (CQ-AX-01, Q-D10-14). Sentences stay in the sealed report ledger; an item points into the body with offsets. Insert-only with its Report: a revision is a new Report with new items. Row rule: a ROW ASSESSES exactly one entity, its option; the target, population or other context of a row is on the enclosing SECTION's or the Report's ASSESSES, and a blocking scope is the UseConstraint's (report-skeletons.md rule 9). Identity rule: (report uid, itemKey). uid token: `report-item` (hu:report-item:<opaque>). nodes.name: Source
nodes.description: Purpose: stable identity of one retrieval endpoint (one normalized canonicalUri): a page, registry record, PDF, API record, feed item or media file. Identity rule: `canonicalUri` (normalized post-redirect endpoint; never an identifier resolver). uid token: `source` (hu:source:<host-path-slug>). Implements Subjectable so identifiers (DOI of the endpoint, NCT of a registry record page) and assertions about the endpoint (retracted, paywalled) attach without a domain type. Editorial containers (MediaWork, Channel) are D9 types; scholarly publications are D3 Publications (R-09, R-71). A Source is grouped with its work by RENDITION_OF (kernel meaning, asserted, recorded time only; declared IN on D9 MediaWork.renditions and D3 Publication.renditions; R-43). Its source family is the OCCURS_IN work of the evidence, else its RENDITION_OF work, else the Source itself. Curation files (target and frontier vocabularies, the D2 hallmark mapping) are Sources with one snapshot per version (R-26). Questions: Q-K-01, Q-K-10, Q-K-20, Q-K-21.

"""

funder, award or condition. Also absorbs pinned TrialRegistration (registration ids are
kernel Identifiers; the registry history is RegistrationVersion) and Dataset (a reused cohort or IPD set is a Study of
kind OBSERVATIONAL_COHORT that secondary analyses REPORT_ON).
Identity rule: any registry identifier (NCT, ISRCTN, EUCT, EUDRACT) attached through the kernel; two registrations of one
trial (NCT01038583 = ISRCTN83772183) are two Identifiers on one Study. Unregistered studies: (first reporting
publication DOI or PMID, studyKind, normalized design label, e.g. ITP cohort + compound).
uid token: `study` (hu:study:<opaque>).
Status fields are a read-only projection cache of the latest open HAS_REGISTRATION_VERSION episode (method in
projectionMethodVersion, e.g. study-registry-projection/v1; source uid in projectionOfRegistrationVersionUid; written by a
PROJECTION Activity at projectionDerivedAt); authority is the RegistrationVersion.
Questions: CQ-ST-01, CQ-ST-04, CQ-ST-07, CQ-ST-08, Q-D3-02, Q-D3-04, Q-D3-06, Q-D3-08, Q-D3-09, Q-D3-10, Q-D3-11, Q-D3-18.
"""
type Study implements Entity & Subjectable
  @node(labels: ["Study", "Entity"])
  @query(aggregate: false)
  @mutation(operations: []) {
  id: ID!
  uid: String!
  name: String
  privacyClass: PrivacyClass
  lastWriterRunId: String
  createdAt: DateTime
  updatedAt: DateTime
  "Design (filter: Q-D3-04 ranking, Q-D3-06 preclinical, CQ-ST-07)."
  studyKind: StudyKind!
  acronym: String @filterable(byValue: false) @sortable(byValue: false)
  "Projection cache: phase of the latest registry version (Q-D3-10)."
  phase: [TrialPhase!]
  "Projection cache: status of the latest registry version (Q-D3-02, Q-D3-10, Q-D3-18)."
  overallStatus: RegistryStatus
  "Projection cache: expected or actual primary completion of the latest version (Q-D3-02, Q-D3-10)."
  primaryCompletionDate: DateTime
  primaryCompletionDateType: RegistryDateType @filterable(byValue: false) @sortable(byValue: false)
  "Projection cache: true when the latest registry version has posted results (Q-D3-02)."
  resultsPosted: Boolean
  "uid of the RegistrationVersion the cache was projected from."
  projectionOfRegistrationVersionUid: String @filterable(byValue: false) @sortable(byValue: false)
  "Method version of the projection cache (directive rule 8)."
  projectionMethodVersion: String @filterable(byValue: false) @sortable(byValue: false)
  projectionDerivedAt: DateTime @filterable(byValue: false) @sortable(byValue: false)
  """class: asserted (state attachment); cardinality: many (EXCLUSIVE per registry: one open valid-time episode per registry, register field exclusive: true, executor-enforced (R-10); reconstructed versions carry the registry's stated date as valid time); questions: CQ-ST-04, CQ-ST-08, Q-D3-02, Q-D3-16, Q-D3-18."""
  registrationVersions: [RegistrationVersion!]!
    @relationship(type: "HAS_REGISTRATION_VERSION", direction: OUT, properties: "AssertedEdgeProperties", nestedOperations: [CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)
  """class: structural; cardinality: many (one per arm per stating source); questions: CQ-ST-01, Q-D3-01, Q-D3-05, Q-D3-06."""
  arms: [StudyArm!]!
    @relationship(type: "HAS_ARM", direction: OUT, properties: "StructuralEdgeProperties", nestedOperations: [CREATE, CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)
  """class: structural; cardinality: many (eligible / enrolled / randomized / analyzed per stating source); questions: Q-D3-17, Q-D3-06, Q-D3-04, Q-D3-07."""
  populations: [StudyPopulation!]!
    @relationship(type: "HAS_POPULATION", direction: OUT, properties: "StructuralEdgeProperties", nestedOperations: [CREATE, CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)
  """class: structural; cardinality: many (one per distinct measure, timepoint and declared priority); questions: CQ-ST-05, CQ-ST-03, Q-D3-04, Q-D3-16."""
  outcomes: [OutcomeDefinition!]!
    @relationship(type: "HAS_OUTCOME", direction: OUT, properties: "StructuralEdgeProperties", nestedOperations: [CREATE, CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)
  """class: asserted; cardinality: many (one episode per party, role and asserting registry or paper; registries disagree: ASPREE lead sponsor Hennepin on CTG vs Monash on ISRCTN; D7 declares no inverse); questions: Q-D3-08, Q-D3-09, Q-D3-02, Q-D3-10."""
  roles: [StudyParty!]!
    @relationship(type: "HAS_STUDY_ROLE", direction: OUT, properties: "StudyRoleEdgeProperties", nestedOperations: [CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)
  """class: asserted; cardinality: many (conditions the registry or paper says the study investigates, resolved to D2 Condition; verbatim names stay on RegistrationVersion.conditionsVerbatim); questions: Q-D3-10."""
  conditions: [Condition!]!
    @relationship(type: "INVESTIGATES", direction: OUT, properties: "AssertedRecordedProperties", nestedOperations: [CONNECT], aggregate: false)
    @filterable(byValue: true, byAggregate: false)
}

nodes.description: Purpose: one arm or group of a study as one source states it (registry arms/groups, paper randomization groups) — the unit results, adverse events and administered components hang on. Absorbs pinned StudyIntervention (arm-level intervention facts are on its InterventionComponents). Registry and paper arms are separate nodes (NCT04313634 has a fisetin arm with a serious adverse event that the paper reports only as dropped), so Q-D3-01 is a set difference. Identity rule: (study, sourceFamily, armKey, payloadHash of arm + components); sourceFamily = registry + registrationId for registry versions, the work's DOI (else PMID) for a publication. Stable: a later version of the same registry that states an identical arm adds a STATED_IN episode to the same node; a changed arm is a new node. uid token: `study-arm`. Questions: CQ-ST-01, CQ-ST-06, Q-D3-01, Q-D3-15, CQ-ST-02.

nodes.name: Target
nodes.description: Purpose: one curated goal people pursue (sleep, strength, brain fitness, body composition, longevity, energy, mood, recovery ...): the shared targets vocabulary (00-DIRECTIVE 3.1; packets/D5/vocab-targets.yaml). Every "what helps / hurts T" and "what is this for" question starts or ends here. Means never point at a Target with a typed edge or a property: they reach it as the object of a kernel Assertion (predicate INTENDED_FOR_TARGET | IMPROVES_TARGET | WORSENS_TARGET | NO_EFFECT_ON_TARGET | MIXED_EFFECT_ON_TARGET) or of a kernel Assessment (ASSESSES, effectDirection). Hierarchy is the `parentKey` property (2 levels). Not a molecular target (D2), not a Condition (D2), not a Frontier (D13). Identity rule: `key` (target:<slug>), stable, never reused; MeSH / Wikidata ids attach through the kernel. Not a D2 Outcome either: an Outcome is a study-independent endpoint concept (all-cause mortality, handgrip strength, sleep quality as an endpoint) that a Target is OPERATIONALIZED_BY; the Target is what a person pursues, the Outcome how a study scores it (09 D-19). uid token: `target` (hu:target:<slug>). Questions: Q-D5-01, Q-D5-02, Q-D5-03, Q-D5-14, Q-D5-15, Q-D5-18, Q-D5-19, Q-D5-20, Q-D5-28.

nodes.name: UseConstraint
nodes.description: Purpose: the shared, stable identity of one scoped use concern, "use of S [above a dose band] [by a route] [in a jurisdiction] together with these scope members (population codes, D2 conditions, co-exposures)". Many sources state the same concern with different levels (a label: "must not be taken"; a clinic: "interaction"; a forum: deliberate use); each statement is a kernel Assertion (predicate USE_CONSTRAINED_IN | INTERACTS_WITH | HAS_UPPER_LIMIT, level in valueString, population in qualifiers) and resolves here by RESOLVES_TO_CONSTRAINT (derived, identity rule use-constraint-key/v2). Recommendations and answers cite its uid as the blocking constraint (CQ-RC-06; D10 ReportItem -BLOCKED_BY-> UseConstraint, declared by D10, R-75); an empty result means "no constraint recorded", never "safe". The subject means and the scope members are the subject and object of the resolving Assertions (kernel HAS_SUBJECT / HAS_OBJECT); they are not duplicated as typed edges here. It carries scope descriptors only (R-76): no level, verdict, direction-of-effect or "safe/unsafe" property; the level and the exposure change belong to each asserter (Assertion.valueString; qualifier exposureChange:<code>). It is a projection-minted grouping of safety Assertions: not a kernel Claim and never vetted (R-76; 09 D-17). A Claim's identity binds the predicate and the stated value, while one UseConstraint groups statements across three predicates and every level, and its typed dose band, scope and timing window are what Q-D5-06 / Q-D5-23 filter. Identity rule (use-constraint-key/v2): identityKeyHash = sha256(identityKey) where identityKey = canonical string of (kind, subject uid, sorted scope member uids and population codes, dose band, route, jurisdiction, timing window; empty components kept empty) under identityKeyVersion. v1 had no timing component (OQ-D5-29). uid token: `use-constraint`. Questions: Q-D5-03, Q-D5-04, Q-D5-05, Q-D5-06, Q-D5-09, Q-D5-11, Q-D5-21, Q-D5-23, CQ-RC-06, Q-D5-24, Q-D5-26.

interfaces.name: Subjectable
interfaces.description: The thin interface for anything an Assertion can be about, an Identifier can identify, a D9 Chunk can mention, an Assessment, Report or Activity can assess, or an asserter can be. Every domain entity type implements `Entity & Subjectable`; kernel implementers are Source, Agent and Claim. A versioned state that carries a registry identifier, or that is the subject or object of an Assertion or the target of an Assessment, implements `Entity & Subjectable`; other payload and retrieval structures implement `Entity` only (R-18). The subject of an Assertion is the most specific record the source speaks about; evidence rolls up to the parent through the state episodes. It declares no relationship fields: the kernel edges that target it (HAS_SUBJECT, HAS_OBJECT, ASSERTED_BY, HAS_IDENTIFIER, ASSESSES) are declared once, on kernel types, and D9 declares MENTIONS (derived) on Chunk, so adding an implementer costs one enum value in the executable schema. Domain edges that target it: kernel-meaning types (ASSESSES, DERIVED_FROM, MENTIONS) plus two registered exceptions, D10 ASSOCIATES (derived) and D5 STEP_USES (structural, executor-checked type list); any other domain edge to Subjectable needs a kernel amendment (R-28). Questions: Q-K-01, Q-K-12, Q-K-14.

edgePropertyTypes.description: Asserted line of a label's declared composition (one Supplement Facts / Nutrition Facts / ingredient-statement row). Each line is authorized by its own Assertion (predicate DECLARES_COMPONENT, subject the LabelVersion, object the line target, asserter the transcribing source, locator the panel row): the resolution of the printed row to a D1/D12 record is attributable, can be adjudicated, keeps recorded-time history when D1 merges or splits materials, and is the input a D1 CALCULATED amount cites in DERIVED_FROM (adversarial-review stage; closes OQ-D6-24(2)). Superset of the kernel AssertedRecordedProperties: its five fields come first, verbatim and in kernel order (A1 rule M11); the label version's HAS_LABEL_VERSION episode carries valid time, so the line carries recorded time only. The qualifiers after the base fields are the ones CQ-AX-25, CQ-PF-01, Q-D6-02, Q-D6-08 and Q-D6-12 filter on. Amounts are declarations, never measurements (measured content is D8). The row as printed ('Niagen (as Nicotinamide Riboside Chloride)'), the form statement ('as pyridoxine HCl') and a per-component allergen or preparation statement are not edge fields (M11: a field that only reproduces the source's wording stays with the Assertion): they are the authorizing Assertion's locator exact text and its qualifiers `declaredName:`, `form:` and `statement:` (R-30).

target, asserter the transcribing source, locator the panel row): the resolution of the printed row to a D1/D12 record is
attributable, can be adjudicated, keeps recorded-time history when D1 merges or splits materials, and is the input a D1
CALCULATED amount cites in DERIVED_FROM (adversarial-review stage; closes OQ-D6-24(2)). Superset of the kernel
AssertedRecordedProperties: its five fields come first, verbatim and in kernel order (A1 rule M11); the label version's
HAS_LABEL_VERSION episode carries valid time, so the line carries recorded time only. The qualifiers after the base fields
are the ones CQ-AX-25, CQ-PF-01, Q-D6-02, Q-D6-08 and Q-D6-12 filter on. Amounts are declarations, never measurements

enums.name: CaptureFailureKind
enums.description: Why an attempt did not yield a complete capture (observed 2026-10-08 across the first-tier tools; tooling/action-space.yaml evidence).
enums.summary: Why an attempt did not yield a complete capture (observed 2026-10-08 across the first-tier tools; tooling/action-space.yaml evidence).

values.name: AUTH_REQUIRED
values.description: 401 or login redirect: key or account required (CAS Common Chemistry, fhir.loinc.org).

values.name: FORBIDDEN
values.description: 403 by policy, including identity headers missing (CT.gov internal history API, EDGAR without declared User-Agent, regulations.gov attachment via curl).

values.name: BOT_CHALLENGE
values.description: 200 with an error or challenge page instead of content (Firecrawl scrape of the CT.gov history tab returned 'Error | ClinicalTrials.gov').

values.name: RATE_LIMITED
values.description: 429 transient throttle (USDA FDC DEMO_KEY shared per IP, Semantic Scholar unkeyed).

values.name: QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
values.description: Daily or monetary budget spent (OpenAlex X-RateLimit-Limit-USD without key).

values.name: TIMEOUT
values.description: No response in the client deadline (WHO ICTRP, 60 s).

values.name: SERVER_ERROR
values.description: 5xx from the source.

values.name: LICENCE_RESTRICTED
values.description: Content exists but the licence forbids capture or storage (LOINC table, KEGG, DrugBank, Natural Medicines).

values.name: NO_TEXT_LAYER
values.description: Bytes have no text layer (image-only PDF FDA-2022-S-0023-0068); OCR needed.

values.name: LOSSY_RENDITION
values.description: Third-party rendition (kernel contentHashBasis TOOL_RENDITION) dropped characters versus the issuer bytes (beta sign lost in a Firecrawl PDF rendition).

values.name: PARSE_ERROR
values.description: Bytes received; the parser could not read them.

values.name: CLIENT_ERROR
values.description: The calling client failed (CLI console-encoding crash), not the source.

enums.sdl:
"Why an attempt did not yield a complete capture (observed 2026-10-08 across the first-tier tools; tooling/action-space.yaml evidence)."
enum CaptureFailureKind {
  "401 or login redirect: key or account required (CAS Common Chemistry, fhir.loinc.org)."
  AUTH_REQUIRED
  "403 by policy, including identity headers missing (CT.gov internal history API, EDGAR without declared User-Agent, regulations.gov attachment via curl)."
  FORBIDDEN
  "200 with an error or challenge page instead of content (Firecrawl scrape of the CT.gov history tab returned 'Error | ClinicalTrials.gov')."
  BOT_CHALLENGE
  "429 transient throttle (USDA FDC DEMO_KEY shared per IP, Semantic Scholar unkeyed)."
  RATE_LIMITED
  "Daily or monetary budget spent (OpenAlex X-RateLimit-Limit-USD without key)."
  QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
  "No response in the client deadline (WHO ICTRP, 60 s)."
  TIMEOUT
  "5xx from the source."
  SERVER_ERROR
  "Content exists but the licence forbids capture or storage (LOINC table, KEGG, DrugBank, Natural Medicines)."
  LICENCE_RESTRICTED
  "Bytes have no text layer (image-only PDF FDA-2022-S-0023-0068); OCR needed."
  NO_TEXT_LAYER
  "Third-party rendition (kernel contentHashBasis TOOL_RENDITION) dropped characters versus the issuer bytes (beta sign lost in a Firecrawl PDF rendition)."
  LOSSY_RENDITION
  "Bytes received; the parser could not read them."
  PARSE_ERROR
  "The calling client failed (CLI console-encoding crash), not the source."
  CLIENT_ERROR
  OTHER
}

Activity.policy: create at run start; update endedAt, receiptIds, digests, policyOutcome at apply

Assertion.policy: create; close once (recordedTo, status SUPERSEDED / status from adjudication); never delete

Association.policy: projection job only: create; close with recordedTo on recompute; may delete a superseded record no Report or ReportItem cites (R-48)

Biomarker.policy: create; update descriptive fields; never delete

CaptureAttempt.policy: create only (immutable; a retry is a new attempt); never update or delete

CertificationListing.policy: create; latest observed status rewritten under FIELD Assertions (R-14, R-45; history = COVERS episodes and snapshots); never delete

Claim.policy: create; update projection caches (lifecycleState, latestVerdict, refinesClaimUid; discourse* by a PROJECTION Activity, R-49) only

DecisionCriterion.policy: create (node.upsert); a new version is a new node naming supersedesUid; never update or delete

Device.policy: create; update descriptive fields; never delete

Event.policy: create (node.upsert); re-materialize clocks from Assertions; never delete

Frontier.policy: create / update only by a vocabulary version bump; never delete

Intervention.policy: create, update; never delete (packet: create true, update true, delete false)

LabTest.policy: create; update descriptive fields; never delete

LabelVersion.policy: create; update observation cache fields only (content is immutable); never delete

LegalStatus.policy: create only (immutable; when it holds is the STATUS_OF episode, a change of any identity key is a new LegalStatus)

Lot.policy: create; property caches rewritten under FIELD Assertions (R-14, R-45); never delete

Metric.policy: create; update descriptive fields; never delete

Patent.policy: create; aggregator status and expiry caches rewritten under FIELD Assertions (R-14, R-45); never delete

Protocol.policy: create, update; never delete (packet: create true, update true, delete false)

ProtocolEdition.policy: create only; never update or delete (packet: create true, update false, delete false)

ProtocolStep.policy: create only; never update or delete (packet: create true, update false, delete false)

QualityResult.policy: create; a re-capture of the same report re-anchors its locators and reuses the row; never delete

RegulatoryRecord.policy: create; property caches rewritten under FIELD Assertions (R-14, R-45); a revised letter or a new response is a new record, never an edit; never delete

Report.policy: create (report.publish); close once on revision or withdrawal

ReportItem.policy: create only, with its Report (report.publish); insert-only

Target.policy: create, update; never delete (packet: create true, update true, delete false)

UseConstraint.policy: create only; never update or delete (packet: create true, update false, delete false)

outcomeVerbatim:.description: Outcome as the source names it, when it is not resolved to a uid (KN-15 separate grammar).

section:.name: section
section:.valueGrammar: code:D5.label-section (CONTRAINDICATIONS | WARNINGS | PRECAUTIONS | CAUTIONS | BOXED_WARNING | PROTOCOL_TEXT | DRUG_INTERACTIONS ...)
section:.description: Label or protocol section the constraint was stated in (USE_CONSTRAINED_IN).

jurisdiction:.name: jurisdiction
jurisdiction:.description: Jurisdiction of a constraint, authorized dose range or claim.

jurisdiction=.name: jurisdiction
jurisdiction=.description: D1 packet spelling of jurisdiction:. Re-key to jurisdiction:.

exposureChange:.name: exposureChange
exposureChange:.description: Direction of an interaction, per asserter (never a UseConstraint property).

stance:.name: stance
stance:.description: Whether the interaction statement advises avoidance or deliberate use.

ageBand:.name: ageBand
ageBand:.description: Age band of an upper limit (<low>-<high> years as printed).

intakeScope:.name: intakeScope
intakeScope:.description: Whether a limit covers supplemental or total intake.

limitKind:.name: limitKind
limitKind:.description: Kind of upper limit (PROTOCOL_MAX = a protocol author's own ceiling).

use:.name: use
use:.description: Use scope of an authorized dose range as stated.

basis:.name: basis
basis:.description: MD-D5-02: mass basis of a stated amount (salt form, active moiety, nutrient equivalent, material as is, unspecified). Never inferred; ambiguous basis is UNSPECIFIED plus notReportedFields where the type has them. No elemental-mass inference.

referent:.name: referent
referent:.description: MD-D5-02: what a stated amount refers to (as named, as nutrient, extract mass, marker constituent, blend total, not declared).

direction:.name: direction
direction:.description: Direction of a preparation-driven content change (D12); D4 INTERFERES_WITH uses it for the source-stated bias direction (text).

preparationMethod:.name: preparationMethod
preparationMethod:.description: Preparation method; repeat the key for several values.

preparationVerbatim:.name: preparationVerbatim
preparationVerbatim:.description: Source wording of a preparation (free text; never filtered).

duration:.name: duration
duration:.description: ISO 8601 duration (D12 preparation; D5 target-effect statements).

cycles:.name: cycles
cycles:.description: Number of preparation cycles; `<=N` for 'up to N'.

comparator:.name: comparator
comparator:.description: MD-D12-02 / R-57: a comparison OPERATOR from the D1 QuantityComparator enum (GTE, LTE, ...; absent = EQ). Never a uid: a comparator arm is comparatorArm:.

comparatorArm:.name: comparatorArm
comparatorArm:.description: MD-D12-02: uid of the comparator StudyArm a result or claim is stated against (the PREDIMED / UPF fixtures wrote it as comparator:hu:...).

derivation:.name: derivation
derivation:.description: Source derivation code of a food composition value.

dataPoints:.name: dataPoints
dataPoints:.description: Number of data points behind a composition value.

role:.name: role
role:.description: Role of a component in a dietary pattern statement (D12); D5 INTERVENTION_INCLUDES role as stated (text).

species:.name: species
species:.description: Species of an adverse-effect finding (NCBI taxon uid or HUMAN | LABORATORY_ANIMALS).

doseContext:.name: doseContext
doseContext:.description: Dose context of a food-constituent harm statement.

issueDate:.name: issueDate
issueDate:.description: Print issue date of a notice (HAS_REVISION_STATUS flag with no identified notice, R-44).

reportingLimit:.name: reportingLimit
reportingLimit:.description: Reporting limit of a measured content value as stated (number + unit).

role=.name: role
role=.description: Role of an organization or person in an Event (authorizing Assertion of INVOLVES).

primary=.name: primary
primary=.description: Marks the one EVENT_ABOUT Assertion naming the primary subject of an Event.

amountKind=.name: amountKind
amountKind=.description: Kind of a financing amount (e.g. GROSS_PROCEEDS, BORROWING_CAPACITY).

amountBasis=.name: amountBasis
amountBasis=.description: Basis of a financing amount (e.g. COMMITTED, AVAILABLE, SOLD).

edition=.name: edition
edition=.description: Edition of a frontier-classification input as stated.

derivedFrom=.name: derivedFrom
derivedFrom=.description: Input record a D13 classification statement was derived from.

frontierVocabVersion=.name: frontierVocabVersion
frontierVocabVersion=.description: Version of frontiers.yaml a frontier classification used (pin R-60).

classificationRule=.name: classificationRule
classificationRule=.description: Versioned frontier classification rule id (e.g. frontier-classification/v1).

legacy:recordedFrom=.name: legacy:recordedFrom
legacy:recordedFrom=.description: Legacy system record time of the migrated element, kept verbatim; v2 recordedFrom is the migration commit time.

legacy:extractedAt=.name: legacy:extractedAt
legacy:extractedAt=.description: Legacy extraction time stated by the legacy record; never a v2 observation or valid time.

legacy:runId=.name: legacy:runId
legacy:runId=.description: Legacy research run id (mongoResearchRunId) of the migrated element; the v2 lineage is the legacy research Activity (WAS_INFORMED_BY).
